about.title: About me
about.paragraph1: I am an environmental physicist passionate about climate systems, ocean-atmosphere interactions and climate variability. My expertise relies on the mastery of advanced numerical tools applied to climate science.
about.paragraph2: My research focuses on regional climate modelling (RegCM5, in-situ and satellite data) and ocean modelling (CROCO, in-situ and satellite data). I am currently enrolled in the ICTP Postgraduate Diploma Programme in Earth System Physics (Trieste, Italy).
about.paragraph3: I hold a Research Master's degree in Physics, specialized in Environmental Physics, where I worked on: "Investigating the Atmospheric Stability over Central Africa Using a Regional Climate Model".

list.school: Abdus Salam International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP)
list.description: Pre-doctoral postgraduate programme in Earth System Physics, coordinated by Riccardo Farneti. Term I (Sept–Dec 2026): Wave Physics, Physics of the Earth for Geohazards, Atmospheric Thermodynamics, Climate Physics, Geophysical Fluid Dynamics, Linux Basics, Numerical Methods I, Scientific Python. Term II (Jan–May 2027): Numerical Methods and Data Analysis in GeoScience, Atmospheric Dynamics, Ocean Dynamics, BioGeochemical Cycles, Earth System Modelling, plus Solid Earth courses (Seismology, Space Geodesy & InSAR, Volcano Physics, Tectonophysics).
list.description_en: Pre-doctoral postgraduate programme in Earth System Physics. Core courses: wave physics, Earth physics applied to geohazards, atmospheric thermodynamics, climate physics, geophysical fluid dynamics, numerical methods, Linux and scientific Python, followed by advanced teaching and a research thesis.
